sentences.en: When they left, I got out of the barrel.
I went to the captain, the doctor and Trelawney.
I told them everything I had heard.
The captain said: it is good that you heard.

sentences.ar: عدينا الناس: احنا سبعة وهم تسعتعش.
sentences.en: We counted the men: we were seven and they nineteen.

sentences.ar: قال الكابتن: بنستنى وما بنبين إشي.
sentences.en: The captain said: we wait and we show nothing.
